references.name: reference/view1-north
references.shows: The whole map from above the coach road, looking south over the town, the flat and the body.

references.name: reference/view2-plan
references.shows: The map as a plan, north at the top: town, flat, black water and the body lying head to the north.

references.name: reference/view3-west
references.shows: The map from the west, side-on: the town's cliff, the long flat, the channel and the body.

references.name: reference/view4-narrows
references.shows: The body across the black water from the end of the flat, the two ferry houses on either shore.

references.name: reference/view5-south
references.shows: The map from above the body's back, looking north across the flat to the town.

references.name: concept/01-coach-road-near

references.name: concept/28-the-stomach-far
references.shows: The Stomach, far view: A cutaway of the stomach chamber deep in the body, the pool and its curb, the way from the chest above and to the heart beyond.

references.shows: Heart Chamber, near view: A living chamber.

references.shows: Heart Chamber, far view: A cutaway of the heart chamber in the body, the heart and its three valves, a short tunnel leading out through a wound in the flank to the ridge outside, and a stair going up the neck.
